Analyze this public dataset containing information on a housing rental market. Conduct your analysis with an original script written by you using any appropriate tool, including but not limited to Python or R: [Australian Rental Market Data 2026](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/kanchana1990/australian-rental-market-data-2026)

1.  Describe the quality of the data and clean it appropriately.

2.  Analyze an important aspect of the data using a supervised or unsupervised model and justify your modeling choices using statistical criteria.

3.  Construct a visualization conveying the implications or impact of your model.

4.  Describe potential next steps, considering both value and level of effort.
